name: AI via OpenRouter
description: AI completions via OpenRouter. Supports chat, text generation, and streaming. Access to Claude, GPT-4, Llama, Mistral and more.

envVars.name: OPENROUTER_SITE_URL
envVars.description: Your site URL for OpenRouter rankings

envVars.name: OPENROUTER_APP_NAME
envVars.description: Your app name for OpenRouter rankings

dbTables.name: ai_log
dbTables.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT, model TEXT NOT NULL, prompt_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0, completion_tokens INTEGER DEFAULT 0, total_cost REAL DEFAULT 0, purpose TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'success', created_at TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now')))
indexes: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_log_user ON ai_log(user_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_log_model ON ai_log(model, created_at DESC)

routes.description: Get AI usage stats for current user
